name: Damone's Love Diary
source:
Damone and his boyfriend Ian have been living a happy love life. However, one day, Ian's childhood friend suddenly appears and shatters this tranquility, causing a crack in the relationship between the two. Damone's emotions, faced with the setback in his relationship, become increasingly extreme, eventually leading to an irreparable situation...
